starvfx.tree.whisper.strong.0: I felt you coming. Come closer.
starvfx.tree.whisper.strong.2: You came back. My branches knew before I did.
starvfx.tree.whisper.strong.3: Rest a moment by my side.
starvfx.tree.whisper.strong.4: Tell me what you saw out there.
starvfx.tree.whisper.strong.5: How good to hear footsteps again.
starvfx.tree.whisper.strong.6: My children always find their way back.
starvfx.tree.whisper.strong.7: Kneel by my roots if you are hurt.
starvfx.tree.whisper.weak.0: Forgive me... it is hard to shine today.
starvfx.tree.whisper.weak.1: Do not fear for my branches. I am still here.
starvfx.tree.whisper.weak.2: It is cold in my roots.
starvfx.tree.whisper.weak.3: Stay a while. It hurts less with you near.
starvfx.tree.whisper.weak.4: Did you find him? No... do not tell me yet.
